scope: Tracked metadata inventory; not a new geometry, photo or browser acceptance audit
unknown_count_reason: The feature identity ledger links baseline representations and model registrations, but does not provide complete per-feature acceptance. Navigation entries and catalog records are different units, so subtraction or a completion percentage would be misleading. Existing per-model proofs retain their own scope; this report does not revalidate them.

source_gap_checks.response_storage: Decoded JSON saved in private research cache; hash binds that JSON serialization, not HTTP wire bytes; full response not redistributed
source_gap_checks.method: For complete ways tagged building/building:part/bridge/water/waterway/natural, test entire geometry covered by museum compound polygon using Shapely. Relation geometries and independent imagery were not reviewed by this check.
source_gap_checks.finding: No separately mapped pool, bridge or building entirely inside the compound was found by this bounded OSM query; this is not proof that no other survey sources exist.
